The Internal Complaint Committee (ICC)
×
The Internal Complaint Committee (ICC) is constituted as per the UGC Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal of Sexual Harassment of Women Employees and Students in Higher Educational Institutions Regulations, 2015. The above Regulations are based on the Government of India's Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013. In compliance with the UGC statutes regarding measures for ensuring the safety of women and Programmes for Gender Sensitization on Campus, the ICC is committed to a zero tolerance policy towards sexual harassment and strives to create a campus free from discrimination, harassment or sexual assault at all levels.

I welcome all to Lalit Chandra Bharali College, Maligaon, Guwahati. This institution of Higher Education provides different career oriented courses. The College (popularly known as LCB College) has a multidisciplinary nature of courses as well as multi dimensional activities including extra curricular activities. The uniqueness of the College is its programmes on non-traditional subjects like Computer Science and Electronics. Presently, the College runs two provincialised streams (Arts and Science) with fifteen departments. Apart from two provincialised streams, at present the College provides self sustaining courses such as BCA, B.Sc.(IT) and PGDCA. In both the streams, Honours course is offered in many departments. New infrastructural facilities have strengthened the academic environment of the College. NCC and NSS wings of the College are very active wings through which the students of the College can give services to the greater society.

In this highly competitive world, there will be no other options than to do hard work and go ahead with proper planning. I do sincerely hope that the students of LCB College will mainly concentrate in their studies with the guidance of a team of dedicated faculty members who have been working since 1971to bring the College to its present position. Since its inception, strong benchmarks have been laid in different activities in the College in terms of teaching, learning, research and other corporate activities. Presently, many new concepts have been developed in the campus for the betterment of the College in general and welfare of the students community in particular.

In the new millennium, the scenario in higher education has undergone unprecedented changes. The present day challenges have been brought out by Globalization, Privatization and Liberalization on one hand and our exorbitantly high expectations on the other hand. Further, in order to cope up with the future challenges, we as stakeholders must prepare ourselves to work with more devotion and sincere efforts.

I am pleased to share that recently, National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC) has accredited this premiere College with B++ Grade. I do hope, LCB College, our Alma Mater, which has recently celebrated it's Golden Jubilee will march ahead in the days to come bringing laurels. We must move with the pace of changing and challenging times. Of course, an educational institution should not be judged solely by its academic credentials but also by its various contribution and impact on the society at large. It is our great  that LCB College shall be at par in academic excellence and intellectual pursuits not only in the state of Assam, but also in the entire North  Eastern Region of India. I am sure, the flag of LCB College and its motto will certainly soar high in the days to come.

I offer hearty welcome to all the new comers. At last, I wish all the stakeholders a bright and prosperous future.
From The Principal's Desk
